contents.entry: Purpose and the three columns every code carries
The code map: one element per code with meaning, lamp, who acts and the kinds that carry it
Owner-acts: the records that become exactly one card
Plan and ledger codes (the rail panel)
Outbox effect states and their lamps (not codes)

pointers.shared: N-43 loads this map into the store as code.table
N-28 turns owner-acts records into cards
N-41 lists every record whose code acts is owner

purpose.s: This is the one status code map of the rebuilt factory (brief C hard rule 5: every status has a code in the shared map).

The set is HTTP-shaped and taken as-is from the field (02-MAPPING V01, SPEC-01 STC-http-shaped, SPEC-17 s-codes, events/schema/event.schema.json), with three additions the node volumes needed: 206 degraded, 403 refused (authorization by principal), 410 superseded, 502 unreachable and 504 timeout; 404 is carried for the machine screen only.
Every code carries three columns: value and name, lamp (what a screen draws) and acts (who moves next: system, owner, seat or nobody).

A kind is a dotted lowercase record name declared in its node volume's status-codes section; shared/record-kinds.xml is generated from those sections (bin/make-kinds.py) and is what N-43 loads; the emitter rows below name every kind under every code it carries, which check.sh C18 enforces, so adding a kind is an edit to its node volume, a regenerated registry and a row here, then a reload, never a code change.
A code whose acts is owner is an alert row by property of the code (N-41) and exactly one card by N-28 (owner-acts below); nothing else reaches the owner.

status-code.meaning: Exists or in progress: the record opens a traversal or marks a step still running; the next node on the edge acts on the next tick.
status-code.acts: system: the next node on the DAG edge; never a wait by a seat.

status-code.name: degraded
status-code.meaning: Partial: a frame rendered with some panels stale or missing; the screen says so instead of hiding it.
status-code.acts: system: the next pushed frame replaces it; N-41 lists it when it persists past map.stale_after_s.
status-code.emitter: map.degraded

status-code.name: routed
status-code.meaning: Routed or informational: a card was posted, a message was routed by rule, a question is open, or a rule bit a rebuild ticket under build mode.
status-code.acts: owner for a card (card, break.glass, promotion.confirm, art.gap); system for routed.message, rule.bit, plan.question routing; the owner answers on the page, never in a reply.

status-code.name: invalid
status-code.meaning: Bad record: schema refused, unknown code, bad map or registry entry, unkeyable row; the writer is wrong, not the system.
status-code.acts: system: N-11 on a validator refusal, plus a defect on N-15 when two schema checks disagree; owner only for a code map that fails to load (N-43 keeps the previous table).

status-code.name: refused
status-code.meaning: Authorization: the caller's principal (its peer uid, authority.xml#role-derivation) may not do this; nothing was written. Reasons: unknown_principal, kind_not_permitted, principal_mismatch, capability_expired; for owner-only answers not_relayable; never a lease question (412) and never a race (409).
status-code.acts: system: N-51 counts it by principal and reason; any unknown_principal is an alert row; the caller never retries it.
status-code.emitter: record.refused (unknown_principal, kind_not_permitted, principal_mismatch, capability_expired)
answer.rejected not_relayable (a relayed or defaulted answer to an owner-only card, or an owner word from a non-owner source), control.refused (a non-owner principal used an owner-only verb)

status-code.name: not-found
status-code.meaning: The selection names a node or record that does not exist in the frame; the screen shows the miss.
status-code.acts: nobody; the next frame or selection replaces it.
status-code.emitter: machine.not-found

status-code.name: conflict
status-code.meaning: A store write lost a race, and only that: an entity version conflict (reason version), or an operation key replayed with a different request hash (reason idempotency_mismatch, contracts.xml#operation-keys); the loser re-reads and retries or reports. The one outside value is merge.conflict, the forge's own conflict of a PR with main. A stale lease token is never 409 (412).
status-code.acts: system: the writer re-reads the current version and retries within its retry row (contracts.xml#retry-owner); N-11 on merge.conflict; a second answer to one card is refused for good.
status-code.emitter: record.conflict (version, idempotency_mismatch)
merge.conflict (the forge reports the head conflicts with main), claim race at ticket.ready (the claims row moved under the Commit)
answer.refused (second answer: the ruling:CARD entity already exists), seat_users.bind lost (another run took the pool user)

status-code.name: superseded
status-code.meaning: A newer head sha, main sha, gitops sha or frame replaced this run or check; the superseded work stops and nobody acts on it; the one exception is alert.aged, an open alert past its escalation bound.
status-code.acts: nobody for supersession (N-07 stops the Jenkins build, N-25 posts error superseded); owner for alert.aged.
status-code.emitter: plan.superseded, check.superseded, pod.run superseded, gate.run superseded, main.gate.status superseded
alert.aged (owner-acts)

status-code.name: precondition-refused
status-code.meaning: A precondition failed and the step did not run. Reasons with one meaning book-wide: stale_token (the token is not the lease's current token) and lease_not_current (the lease is not reserved or running, or has expired) at every fenced write (contracts.xml#fencing); not-ready (an owner word before its bootstrap state, naming the missing proofs, cut-over.xml#bootstrap); harness_mismatch (the harness differs from its pin, seat-contract.xml#launch-flags-rule); claim_missing (the ticket does not hold the claims its files need, contracts.xml#claims). Also: a missing ruling, frozen intake, head moved, bundle or workspace mismatch, import not recorded, a second instance, a dirty checkout, a cancel-set mismatch, a transition not in the table.
status-code.acts: system: N-11 by reason (contracts.xml#retry-owner); the owner only for a missing ruling, a frozen intake, protection.drift, or a not-ready reply to their own word.
status-code.emitter: record.stale (stale_token, lease_not_current), lease.stale

status-code.meaning: Rejected with evidence: a check ran and said no (a red gate, a failed test, review changes, a failed promotion attempt, an invalid frame); the evidence is in the record; a result is never retried, only infrastructure is (V05).

status-code.name: blocked
status-code.meaning: Blocked or held: a lease is held by another, a merge hold stands, a card is held, a run ended blocked with a terminal reason, a promotion or a Drive publish needs set-up; the work waits on a named condition with a bound.

status-code.name: unreachable
status-code.meaning: A front door or upstream did not answer: the map is offline or the gitops front door did not serve the new digest.
status-code.acts: system for the first three attempts; owner after 3 (deploy.front-door-unreachable).
status-code.emitter: deploy.front-door-unreachable, map.offline

status-code.name: unavailable
status-code.meaning: Unavailable or halted: the store, disk, forge, stream, mirror, checker, publisher or intake is not serving, or the line is halted by the owner; monitoring never stops under it.
status-code.acts: system: refuse the put once, skip the run, keep ticking; owner for line.halted (a card), store.unavailable, store.disk and backup.disk after N-45 ran, forge.unreachable after three failed polls past forge.stale_after_seconds, Drive not set up.

status-code.name: timeout
status-code.meaning: A bounded wait expired: a deploy, a first frame, a view or a counters tick did not finish inside its bound; the fallback named by the wait runs.
status-code.acts: system: the wait's fallback; N-41 lists it; owner never, unless the same key times out three times (then 500 by the three-attempts rule).
status-code.emitter: deploy.timeout, map.first-frame-timeout, machine.view-timeout, counters.timeout, alerts.view-timeout, controls.view-timeout

lamp.s: The lamp column is what every screen draws for a record of that code: green for 200, 201 and 204; amber for 100, 206, 300, 404, 409, 412, 423, 429 and 504; red for 400, 403, 422, 500, 502 and 503; grey for 410.

N-37 generates the chip and machine bindings from this column; N-38 to N-42 draw it; N-32 and the strip draw the same colours; a screen never invents a fourth state (command-center.xml#look names the hex values).
A machine lamp is the lamp of the newest record of its node; a queue lamp is amber at depth over zero and red at depth over the node's stall bound.

acts.s: The acts column names who moves next and is one of system, owner, seat or nobody.

system: a node of this book acts on the next tick without anyone typing; owner: the record becomes a card (owner-acts) and an alert row; seat: no code names a seat as actor any more, because a seat reads nothing from the store (authority.xml#seat-isolation); the value stays in the schema for the rail plan's codes; nobody: terminal, nothing moves.
Where one code serves kinds with different actors (300, 410, 500, 503), the acts element of the code names the kinds that differ; N-43 loads the kind-level override with the table.

owner-acts.s: These are the only records that become cards. N-28 builds exactly one card per dedupe key; a second record with the same key updates the card and never posts another.
owner-acts.row: A ticket exhausted 3 attempts; the card carries the last failure, the attempts and the recommendation; the owner cancels or re-cuts through N-29; key ticket:attempt-set.
Rejected on main with a merge.hold; one card per red main, coalesced by hold id with N-09's merge.hold.aged 500; the owner is an escalation after three failed fixes, never a wait.
A merge.hold stood past merge.hold_age_alert_seconds (default 14400); N-41 alerts, N-28 folds it into the hold's card.
The first pass once (201), then every third consecutive fail (422).
Reason store, disk or crashloop; three watchdog restarts in an hour; tick.missed at three in an hour.

row.kinds: store.corrupt store.unavailable store.disk backup.disk backup.failed backup.rotten backup.mirror_failed ticket.stale intake.orphan lease.failed forge.auth forge.overflow forge.unreachable

owner-acts.row: Each after the bound its node volume names: N-45 cleanup first for disk; three in ten minutes for lease.failed on one key; three in a day for intake.orphan; three failed polls past forge.stale_after_seconds for forge.unreachable; a day for backup.mirror_failed.
At the second 423 on the same key; the first is the system's to retry.
A question the owner alone can answer; break glass is one time and recorded.
The halt and the resume, each one card; monitoring keeps running.
The owner surface itself or the cut-over needs the owner.
An open alert past its escalation bound, once.
Main's protection no longer requires coq/gate from the App; N-09 holds every merge until the owner reapplies it with forge-admin.
Reason admission-refused only: the quota or LimitRange refused a pod at create; one card per configuration hash.
The B7 ready card: owner-only, no default and no deadline (authority.xml#relayable-rulings); it names the proofs and waits for USERGO.

row.kinds: code.table cancel ruling-missing drive-auth stable-promotion other-repository drive-not-set-up build-mode-expiry

owner-acts.row: The G7 owner-only cases: a code map that fails to load, a cancel set that does not match, a missing ruling, Drive authorisation, a stable promotion, rows in another repository, Drive not set up, and build mode expiring with open rebuild tickets.
After three skipped ticks; after 3 attempts (502 then 500).

escalation-bound.s: Every owner-acts code carries escalation_bound_s, default 86400: when a card stands unanswered that long, N-31's tick escalates the alert once to 410 alert.aged with one card (N-41); it never escalates twice.
escalation-bound.bound: merge.hold without a fix ticket after PT2H is an N-41 alert row; the card itself ages at 86400.

owner-surface.s: The owner-surface kinds (G5: N-27 to N-34 and N-52) by code, as those volumes declared them; each kind is registered under exactly one code.

plan.s: The rail panel (N-33) maps a ledger.row status to a code: started and checkpoint 100, complete 200, question 300, blocked 423, issue 500; plan.step and plan.side are 100.
These are the same codes the Execution Rail used (rebuild/factory-rebuild-plan.xml#status-codes), so the plan ledger of the rebuild itself reads under this map without translation.

effect-states.s: An external effect (a Jenkins build, a status post, a push, a merge, a phone push) is a row of the effects table (contracts.xml#outbox), written in the same Commit as the record that decided it; its state is an entity state, not a code, and a screen draws it with these lamps.
effect-states.effect: Decided and committed; not yet sent.
The worker called the provider and has no answer yet.
The provider answered with an external id (queue item, status id, merge sha); not yet read back.
The call's outcome was lost; the worker looks the effect up by its operation id before any resend (failure-cases.xml#unknown-outcome).
Refused by the provider, or not confirmed after the retry row allows; the deciding node writes its own failure kind (for example status.post.failed 500).

many-agents.readers: Every node volume, N-43 at load, N-28, N-37, N-41 and every screen read this file by anchor; fifty seats can read it at once because it is one file with stable ids and no state.
many-agents.writers: One ticket at a time edits it (one file, one in-flight ticket); the edit is a pull request, N-46 checks it, N-43 loads it by hash after the merge; a running service keeps the previous table until the new one loads whole.
many-agents.collision: Two tickets that both need a new kind under a code are two pull requests on this file and the second is refused at readiness (N-03 file claim); a kind emitted under a code whose emitter rows here do not name it fails check.sh C18 before N-43 ever sees it; a put with a code or kind not in the live table is 400 with the live hash in the reason, so a stale writer learns which table is live.
many-agents.test: Load this file with N-43's loader twice from two processes: the second load is an idempotent replay (200) of the same hash, never a second table.

source.note: V01 one append-only log with an HTTP-shaped status code map
the plan's codes, carried unchanged for the rail panel
D12: the system lane builds cards
every status has a code, and every code is in a map that says what it means and who acts on it
the C32 defect: a card never posts unwatched
